title: A worker delegation refuses an isolated worktree path inside the repository when cwd is the main checkout, though project rules require worktrees inside the repository
outcome: A worker delegation refuses an isolated worktree path inside the repository when cwd is the main checkout, though project rules require worktrees inside the repository
acceptance: The refusal rule 'isolated worktree path must be outside the source repository' is located in source, and the cases it intends to prevent are stated

A worker delegation can be given an isolated worktree under the repository's own ignored worktree folder (for example .worktrees/<name>) when cwd is the main checkout, without nesting the child inside a tracked source tree or weakening isolation; a test covers this case and the still-refused unsafe cases
The refusal message names the precondition that failed and the supported placement
